part: main loop: Condition and direction, next data
question: How often does a two-call local Clef labeller name one of the engine's own dials for a story that the engine's full reading gave a dial?
one_change: label the 1736 stored engine stories with two typed Clef choices instead of the 328-question reading

baseline.model: always naming the most common dial

prediction.metric: dial hit among stories with an engine reading
prediction.why: a 60-story pilot gave 0.61 with 28 stories carrying a reading, so the sampling error is large; the labeller picks one dial while the engine may hold several, which caps the hit; go bar for labelling the pool: dial hit 0.50 or more and direction agreement 0.85 or more when the dial hit; second attempt, the first died on one Clef call that timed out, retries added
